capability.summary: Coding model for repository work using textual and visual context.
capability.problem_space: Coding model for repository work using textual and visual context. Applicable tasks include repository changes, code debugging, visual specification implementation, test-driven code revision. Accepts text, image, video input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.

constraint.io_signature: Input modalities: text, image, video | Output modalities: text. Gateway transport support requires verification.

limitations: The model card describes video chat as an experimental feature of the official API; gateway support must be verified separately.

semantic_review.task_profile_basis: Task categories derived from documented operations; no empirical quality ranking or fixed framework role.
semantic_review.context_policy: Legacy configured limit is preserved separately from documented native context; neither proves the supplier limit.
